description: Reported bug: the player's Custodian Guard (led by a Blade Champion) was plainly still in combat, they activated it in the opponent's Fight phase, clicked 'Best Weapons ✨' and confirmed — and the game answered that the targets were outside engagement range, killing the whole activation. Cause: 19.03 makes the bodyguard and its attached CHARACTER ONE unit, so FightPhase._get_eligible_melee_targets measured Engagement Range across BOTH components and offered every enemy either had reached; the dialog then pointed EVERY section at the one selected target; but _rebuild_assignments files each section under its own component unit, and _validate_assign_attacks measures the ATTACKER as that component alone (correctly — 11e 'Select Targets' requires each target to be engaged with the model that has that weapon). The half that had not reached that enemy was rejected and took the batch with it. This scenario builds exactly that geometry — the Custodian Guard locked with one Boyz mob, the Blade Champion locked with another, neither engaged with the other's — and drives the real player path: open the dialog, read the split-engagement warning, click 'Best Weapons ✨', click 'Fight!'. The activation must resolve, with the Guard swinging at ITS mob and the Champion at HIS.
